verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS app builder, but nothing in the evidence shows Base44 itself can be deployed on user infrastructure. The docs describe a managed backend. The eject command, GitHub sync and SDK all still tie apps to a Base44 app ID and to Base44 as the backend service, so they are adjacent code-portability features, not self-hosting of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
